1.mascotDialogue: Same idea as before, one more pointer along for the ride. The catch: every insert now updates four pointers, not two. Miss one, and the list looks perfectly fine in one direction and a shambles in the other.

2.mascotDialogue: Lines 9 to 13 are the four-pointer business: the new node's next and prev, the old neighbour's prev, the target's next. Miss line 11 and prev-traversal quietly breaks while next-traversal carries on as though nothing's wrong.

3.mascotDialogue: Notice the arrows come in pairs now. Every connection between two nodes is really two separate pointers, each agreeing with the other.

4.mascotDialogue: This is precisely why doubly linked lists cause more trouble than singly ones — the forward direction can look immaculate while the backward direction has quietly fallen apart.
